cards.title: Searches that show you
cards.note: We searched four ways a customer might, including “Aunt Mimi's Cake Pops Bartlett TN” and “cake pops Bartlett TN”. None of the 73 results was you: other Bartlett bakeries and wedding directories came up instead.

cards.title: What AI assistants know about you
cards.note: Three AI assistants were asked about Aunt Mimi’s by name and town, three times each, with no web access. Out of 34 things a customer might ask, from your phone number to your flavors, they knew none.

cards.title: What an AI assistant finds by searching the web
cards.note: Across three tries it found your street address, your ZIP code, a phone number, that you make custom cakes, that you have a food truck, your Facebook page and your Instagram. It found no flavor, no price and no way to order.

cards.title: Facts a search engine can read on your Facebook page
cards.note: Another 16 are on the page only inside photos, where a person can read them and a search engine cannot.

cards.title: Facts that are only in photos, anywhere
cards.note: Across Facebook, Instagram and Google: all eight cake pop flavors, both cake pop prices and the ice cream.
